title: Koolmore — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Koolmore.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Commercial Value." Value tier. Koolmore makes value commercial and semi-commercial kitchen equipment — reach-in coolers, prep tables, and display cases. Growing in the small business market.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Small restaurants, food trucks, commercial kitchen startups.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Koolmore:

• Lowest-cost commercial kitchen equipment

• Good for food startups

• NSF certification on applicable models

• Wide selection of commercial formats

• Online ordering convenience
